title: JSON Lines request and response frames; byte limits specified in README
$comment: The response envelope carries no method field, so x-methods maps every method to its request and result definition; contract tests validate both directions against this file. Result definitions describe the worker's published result shape for Version 1 (0.2.1). Params schemas enforce structure, keys, types, ranges and path/name shape; checks that depend on disk or referenced file state (inbox existence, image signature, duplicate assets, content size, revision currency) remain worker-side and can still reject a schema-valid request with E_ASSET_MISSING/E_PARAMS/E_REVISION_CONFLICT/E_LIMIT.
